title: SAST scan result
description: One static-analysis run from a CI pipeline. 1.1.0 (#2831) adds repository and findings: one entry per finding, with its severity, its rule id and whether it is suppressed. 1.2.0 (#2973) adds an optional cwe list per finding, which pi1_2 and pi1_3 also select by. The stock checks read the latest scan of each repository; a scan without findings is not judged by them, and an empty findings array is a clean scan.

repository.description: The repository scanned, as one stable name (owner/name, for example). The stock checks key scans by it: the latest scan of each repository decides, and a scan without it is left out.

findings.description: Every finding of the scan, suppressed ones included. Each finding carries only the fields the stock checks read; the full report belongs at report_uri.

rule_id.description: The rule that matched. The stock checks pi1_2 and pi1_3 select by these platform rule ids, or by cwe; a pusher without CWEs maps its scanner's rules onto them: injection.sql, injection.command, deserialization.unsafe and input.schema_violation (input validation); authz.missing_check, authz.idor, authz.privilege_escalation and authz.broken_object_level (authorisation). Any other rule id is kept as sent.

severity.description: The finding's severity, normalised by the pusher to one of these values.

suppressed.description: true when the finding is suppressed in the scanner (an inline ignore, a baseline, a triaged false positive).

cwe.description: The CWE ids the scanner attaches to the rule, each written CWE-<number>: CodeQL's external/cwe/cwe-89 tag and Semgrep's "CWE-89: ..." both become CWE-89. pi1_2 counts a finding under CWE-20, CWE-78, CWE-89 or CWE-502; pi1_3 under CWE-269, CWE-639 or CWE-862. Either the rule id or a CWE selects a finding.
